instruction: Alembic cache export (.abc) `scene.blend` contains a single mesh object named `Blob` - an ICO sphere (radius 1, ~642 verts, ~1280 faces) with two shape keys: - `Basis` (the untouched rest pose). - `Pulse`, whose vertex positions are the basis scaled by 1.5x. The `Pulse` shape key's value is keyframed over 30 frames so the sphere inflates and deflates again: - frame 1 -> value 0.0 - frame 15 -> value 1.0 - frame 30 -> value 0.0 The scene's frame range is already set to `frame_start=1`, `frame_end=30`. Your job: open `scene.blend` and export an Alembic cache of the 30-frame deformation to `animated.abc` (relative to the current working directory). Export requirements - **File path**: `animated.abc`. Overwrite any existing file there. - **Frame range**: the cache must cover frames 1 through 30 inclusive. - **API**: use `bpy.ops.wm.alembic_export` (or an equivalent Blender Alembic exporter). The call `bpy.ops.wm.alembic_export(filepath='animated.abc', start=1, end=30, selected=False, uvs=True, normals=True, vcolors=False, face_sets=False, flatten=False, apply_subdiv=False, packuv=True)` is sufficient. - **Parameters**: `start=1`, `end=30`, `uvs=True`, `normals=True`, `selected=False`. The `Blob` mesh is in the default view layer, so `selected=False` will pick up all visible objects. - **Content**: the resulting `.abc` must be a real Alembic archive (Ogawa or HDF5 container) containing per-frame PolyMesh samples for the `Blob`. Requirements: 1. `animated.abc` exists and is readable. 2. File size > 10 KB (a genuine 30-frame cache of a 642-vert mesh is sizeable). 3. The first bytes of the file are the Alembic\Ogawa magic `Ogawa` OR the HDF5 magic `\x89HDF` (Alembic archives use one of these two containers). 4. Byte-searching the file reveals at least 2 distinct Alembic schema strings from `{PolyMesh,.geom, AbcGeom,.schema}` (evidence of a PolyMesh schema inside). 5. The file size is at least 100 KB (per-frame vertex data for 30 frames dwarfs a single-frame cache), AND the file contains at least 4 distinct PolyMesh sample\schema strings from `{.selfBnds,.childBnds,.faceIndices,.faceCounts,.vals,.ops, AbcGeom, PolyMesh}`.
source: Alembic Project — Alembic 1.x File Format Specification
